title: Craniofacial growth: child and adolescent faces

queue.claim: The 2025 US FTC COPPA rule amendments add biometric identifiers (including face geometry) to 'personal information' for under-13s. GDPR Art. 9 treats identifying face geometry as special-category data, and Art. 8 sets child-consent ages of 13–16.
queue.query: FTC COPPA final rule amendments 2025 biometric identifiers personal information effective compliance date

queue.claim: The Large Scale Facial Model (LSFM, Booth et al. CVPR 2016, ~10,000 faces) includes children and age-specific sub-models, while FLAME and the Basel model are adult-trained.
queue.query: LSFM large scale facial model 10000 faces age range children age-specific models licence
